annotations.title: Create the Reddit post an ad will promote

description: Create the CREATIVE for a Reddit ad. This is the step people skip: a Reddit ad has no creative of its own — it points at a post — so a campaign and ad group with no post behind them can never serve. Types are TEXT (headline + body), IMAGE, VIDEO and CAROUSEL (up to 6 images), and an IMAGE, VIDEO or CAROUSEL post can carry body text too. For image/video/carousel pass media[] with a PUBLIC mediaUrl; Reddit fetches and validates it itself (minimum 140×140), and a video also needs a thumbnailUrl. The destination for a click rides on the media entry’s destinationUrl, NOT on the ad. Reddit’s call-to-action values are human-readable strings with spaces and capitals — "Learn More", "Shop Now", "Sign Up" — not SCREAMING_SNAKE; the error lists all of them. The post is published on the profile immediately, so show the user the exact headline and body first. Reddit builds every post in the background: a TEXT post needs a body, an IMAGE post and every carousel card a destinationUrl. The answer is usually the post, and when Reddit is still building it the answer says pending with a jobId, so call this again with redditProfileId and that jobId (never re-send the post, which would make a second one).

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

allowComments.description: Reddit ads can carry a public comment thread — decide deliberately

body.description: body copy: the text of a TEXT post, or text shown with an IMAGE, VIDEO or CAROUSEL post. Up to 40,000 characters.

callToAction.description: applies to every media entry that has none

headline.description: the post title — this is the ad’s headline

jobId.description: PICK UP a post Reddit was still building: the jobId from an earlier pending answer. Creates nothing new; every other field is ignored.

media.description: one entry for IMAGE/VIDEO, up to 6 for CAROUSEL

callToAction.description: e.g. "Learn More", "Shop Now" — exact human-readable strings

destinationUrl.description: where a click goes — required for image and carousel posts

displayUrl.description: shown instead of the destination; must be the same domain

mediaUrl.description: PUBLIC url of the image/video — Reddit fetches it, minimum 140×140

redditProfileId.description: the Reddit profile id (t2_…) to publish as — from list_reddit_ads_profiles

textFormat.description: how Reddit reads body: PLAIN_TEXT (the default) or RICH_TEXT_JSON, a Reddit rich-text JSON document serialized as a string. Cannot be changed after the post is created.
